libraries.name: Border beam
libraries.useFor: A light that travels around an element's border: AI inputs, active cards, highlighted buttons.

libraries.name: Thinking orbs
libraries.useFor: Small dot-orb indicators for what an agent is doing: thinking, searching, writing, listening.

libraries.name: Gooey
libraries.useFor: Liquid, melting and merging shapes and images: gooey menus, blob transitions, organic backdrops.

libraries.name: Voice
libraries.useFor: An audio-reactive glow for voice input, dictation and voice agents.

libraries.name: Bot avatars
libraries.useFor: Animated bot characters with idle and working states for agents and assistants.

libraries.name: Liquid metal
libraries.useFor: A real-time liquid metal material for buttons, badges, icons and text.

libraries.name: Image
libraries.useFor: Image generation placeholders and reveals while an image is being made or loaded.
